Fill the pair-only regions AB=5, AC=3, BC=2; keep these separate from the triple overlap.
Fill single-only regions A=9, B=6, C=3, then put 6 outside all sets.
Add all eight disjoint regions to get 37; the regions for at least two total 13.
Answer: P(at least two) = 13/37. Each counted outcome occupies exactly one disjoint region.
